structure.unit: Planning, Subdivision of Land and Zoning

law.catch_line: Return of plan to local planning commission; resubmission
law.text: If the governing body disapproves the plan, then it shall be returned to the local planning commission for its reconsideration, with a written statement of the reasons for its disapproval. The commission shall have sixty days in which to reconsider the plan and resubmit it, with any changes, to the governing body.
